chapter.title: Components: .vyx
chapter.lede: A `.vyx` file is one component: a script block of ordinary Vyrn and a template block of markup. A generator compiles it while the program builds, so it is a library, not a compiler feature.

sections.heading: Script and template
prose: The <script> block is ordinary Vyrn: imports, types, the functions the template calls. The <template> block is the view. std/vyx compiles the pair to a Vyrn module while the importing program builds, and vyrn emit-gen prints exactly what it wrote.
A route component can also export head() for the document's title and data() for what the page needs; the server runs data() and the template renders its answer.

sections.heading: Template syntax
prose: {{ x }} puts a value into the page, escaped. :href="f(x)" binds an attribute to an expression. v-for repeats an element over an array, and :key tells the differ which repeated element is which. v-html splices a Markup: a tree rendered by toMarkup, or markup the program owns, marked TrustedMarkup. A String there is refused.
A tag with a capital letter is a component you imported, and its attributes are the props: <Icon name="bytesize:search"/> is a function call written as markup.

sections.heading: This site's routes
prose: Every page of this site is a .vyx route compiled by the same generator, including this one. The reference page lists the whole template surface.
